title: Shalik 1.1.0 - Architectural Modeling Suite for Rhino 8
changelog: New Hole in Wall tool (ArchHole) placed before Door for custom & quick wall opening cuts
Left-click interactive mode prompts for wall/door, sill height, and lintel height
Right-click quick mode cuts openings instantly using previous sill and lintel heights
Permanent hardware fingerprint anchor resilient across Windows Updates
Independent background auto-update agent running outside Rhino via Windows Task Scheduler
Full telemetry auto-registration for all devices and free trial users
Super-optimized 4MB installer package (90% size reduction with zero clutter)
Full compatibility with Rhino 8 Service Releases
